name: GrowerContractDeliveryTracker
tagline: Every grower contract from draft to settlement – tonnes, windows, quality and pace in one app.
description: A complete grain-marketing app for co-ops, elevators, traders and processors: committed vs delivered tonnage, delivery-window timeline with pace and projections, tolerance bands with variance reasons, quality premiums/discounts from a configurable schedule, over/under-delivery alerts, a settlement readiness board and a grower portal view. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: At-risk detection from pace and projection
Record delivery with weighted quality averages
Bulk mark ready / fulfilled / extend windows
Demo mode with fictional sample data
controlType: standard (2 controls: GrowerContractDeliveryTracker data-set + GrowerContractDeliveryTrackerPortal field)
